questions.question: Bharati Shivaji and Kanak Rele are exponents of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharati Shivaji** and **Kanak Rele** are renowned exponents of **Mohiniyattam**, a classical dance form from Kerala.
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is known for its graceful and gentle movements, often described as the dance of the enchantress.
 
• This dance form traditionally involves themes of love and devotion, and its repertoire includes various elements such as the Cholkettu, Varnam, Padam, and Tillana.
 
• **Bharati Shivaji** has been instrumental in the revival of Mohiniyattam and has received numerous awards for her contributions.
 
• **Kanak Rele** is a pioneer in the field of Mohiniyattam and has established the Nalanda Dance Research Centre, which focuses on the research and promotion of Indian classical dance forms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohiniyattam** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• The name **Mohiniyattam** derives from 'Mohini', a mythical enchantress avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, and 'attam', meaning dance.
 
• This dance form is characterized by its elegant costumes, typically a white or off-white sari with a gold border, and distinctive jewelry.
 
• It is performed mainly by women and is marked by its fluid, feminine movements and subtle facial expressions.

questions.question: Thullal dance originated in which of the following states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thullal, **a solo satiric dance form, **originated in Kerala, **India, during the **18th century,** credited to **Kunchan Nambiar,** one of the renowned **Malayalam poets **known as the **Prachina Kavithrayam**.
 
• This art form combines dance and drama, with the performer singing and narrating stories, which requires considerable skill.
 
• Thullal often portrays aspects of the literary, artistic, and cultural milieu of **medieval Kerala**, with episodes from Indian epics presented through straightforward Malayalam poetry.
 
• There are three primary forms of thullal: Ottan Thullal, Parayan Thullal, and Sheethankan Thullal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some **traditional dance forms **from **Kerala**:
 
• **Kathakali: **Known for its elaborate makeup and expressive movements, Kathakali is a classical dance-drama that depicts stories from Hindu mythology through captivating performances.
 
• **Mohiniyattam:** Celebrated for its graceful movements and subtle expressions, Mohiniyattam is a traditional dance form performed mainly by women, showcasing stories of love and devotion.
 
• **Thullal: **Originating in the 18th century, Thullal is a solo satirical dance form introduced by Kunchan Nambiar, featuring storytelling through song and dance, often reflecting Kerala's literary and cultural life.
 
• **Koodiyattam: **Recognized as one of the oldest classical theater forms in the world, Koodiyattam combines dance, music, and drama to present stories from Hindu epics with intricate choreography and vibrant costumes.

• **In India, it is performed in Sikkim.**

• **Tashi Shabdo:** This energetic dance is performed by men and showcases their strength and agility.
 
 
 
• Bhutia dance costumes are elaborate and colorful, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the Bhutia people. Men typically wear long robes and hats, while women wear colorful dresses and jewelry.
